correctness.rationale: For all L>0, N≥1, h0,hL≥0 and individually fixed aj>0, the ground eigenfunction of the real Robin/delta quadratic form is strictly positive. Its principal Prüfer phase θ=atan(u′/(tu)) decreases exactly −t between traps and its jth positive delta jump is at most 2atan(aj/(2t)), sharply only when the incoming/outgoing logarithmic slopes are −aj/2 and +aj/2. The summed inequality bounds t by the unique positive scalar root; the prescribed strictly positive gaps build a globally positive ground eigenfunction attaining equality, and strict equality conditions force every trap location uniquely. The D multiplier is only diffusion normalization. Independent direct harmonic-transfer and first positive root checks for 28 heterogeneous instances and 84 competitors corroborate, not prove, global uniqueness.
